about: A value as every stack writes it into JSON when a program gives it to a part (`invoicePdf.order = current`), to a report (`pdf of Invoice with order = current`), over the web wire, or to `json of`: one text on every stack, compared as written. A decimal or money keeps its places as written ("1250.50", never 1250.5), as text; a whole number is a JSON number, exact to 19 digits (never in exponent form); a date is yyyy-MM-dd and a date and time yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss, as text; no date, no date and time and no reference are null; a reference is its record's number; an empty list is [] (never null). Each case gives the value's `kind`, the `value` (decimals and whole numbers as text, so no reader rounds them) and the `json` every stack writes.

cases.name: a whole decimal keeps its places
